newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Petrochem up on ex-bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: China Petrochem up on ex-bonus issue.

text.p: Taiwan's China Petrochemical Development surged at mid-morning on Tuesday as it went ex-bonus issue, brokers said.
China Petrochemical on Tuesday conducted a bonus issue, or stock dividend, of T$1.6 per share, paying 160 free shares for every 1,000 shares held.
With 65 minutes left, at 0255 GMT, China Petrochemical was up T$1.8 or 4.37 percent to T$43, while the overall index was down 0.31 percent.
Brokers said buying on the share was because China Petrochemical was considered as an asset-backed share.

China Petrochemical has a big piece of land waiting to be converted into a commercial and industrial compound zone, which would generate huge profits for the firm at a time when Taiwan's property market is seeing a gradual recovery, said National Securities analyst Alex Yang.
"China Petrochemical's share price has room to rise further as asset-backed shares and construction stocks are considered as one of the market's bellwether sectors in the second half," Yang said.
